accordion-trigger.text: Can I access my account history?

accordion-content.text: Yes, you can view your complete account history including all transactions, plan changes, and support tickets in the Account History section of your dashboard.
This section contains information about premium features. Upgrade your plan to access this content.

accordion-trigger.text: How do I update my email address?

accordion-content.text: You can update your email address in your account settings. You'll receive a verification email at your new address to confirm the change.
